skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Listen and understand the main content from monologues and dialogues of 3-5 minutes in academic situations.
Take notes on key details from monologues and dialogues of 3-5 minutes in academic situations.
Speak about a variety of topics using mostly simple sentences and some complex structures.
Use 150-200 vocabulary words to present or discuss in business communication situations.
Present an independent speech of 3-5 minutes on familiar business and daily life topics.
Participate and maintain a discussion of 5-7 minutes on familiar business and daily life topics.
Read and understand the main content, find specific details, and infer word meanings based on context.
Identify specific details from reading comprehension texts of 300-500 words on familiar business and daily life topics.
Recognize 100-120 vocabulary words from reading comprehension texts of 200-300 words on familiar business and daily life topics.
Infer word meanings based on context from reading comprehension texts of 300-500 words on familiar business and daily life topics.
Construct successful simple sentence structures and demonstrate effort in using complex sentence structures.
Use simple linking techniques to connect sentences and build a coherent text in business and daily life contexts.
Construct paragraphs in a basic style (discussions, causes and effects, problems and solutions).
